anchors.source_phrase: Falk et al. 2018: country patience vs average years of schooling ρ=0.65 (p<.01); individual patience–education coefficient positive in >90% of countries.
Falk et al. 2018 Table IV Corr(patience, risktaking)=0.230 (n=76); Hanushek et al. 2022 r=0.358 (n=49). θ=0.35 admits the published range and rejects r≳0.6.
Same human-capital implication as conv_edu, written as a leftover rank restriction (θ=0.15).

bootstrap.headline_note: Headline [L,U] remains min/max B* on the full sample; the bootstrap band is additive metadata.

coverage.headline_note: Headline [L,U] remains min/max B* on the full sample; the uncertainty band is additive metadata and never replaces it.
coverage.note: Heuristic uncertainty band over non-empty bootstrap replicates (selection uncertainty on the pooled sample; holdout verdict is a full-sample point finding outside the band). Not a confidence interval; not a holdout-robustness band. Boundary attribution: |margin_m| <= kappa * SE_m.

range.note: range is min/max of beta on M*; bootstrap band is additive metadata (v2.0) and never replaces the headline

theta_grid.note: Diagnostic theta-sensitivity surface only. Headline [L,U] is always lambda=1.0; lambda is never auto-selected.
